What's New in v1.1.0

  • 📝 Description: Add folders and customizable spacers to your layouts, much more reliable Focus Mode switching and auto-revert, safer Dock updates, and major stability improvements.
  • ✨ New: Folders in Dock layouts – add folders alongside your apps and customize how they appear, how their contents are displayed, and how items are sorted.
  • ✨ New: Customizable spacers – add regular, small, or flexible spacers to either side of the Dock, then reorder or adjust them anytime.
  • 📈 Improvements: Focus Mode integration has been extensively rebuilt for better reliability. Modoki now handles an already-active Focus at launch, recovers from missed Focus changes, and restores your previous Dock more consistently when the Focus ends.
  • 📈 Improvements: Safer Dock switching – layout changes are handled one at a time, and Modoki attempts to restore your previous Dock if applying a layout fails.
  • 📈 Improvements: Faster, more responsive interface while loading icons, switching layouts, importing or exporting layouts, and creating diagnostic reports.
  • 📈 Improvements: Better compatibility across Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
  • 📈 Improvements: Safer layout storage and importing, clearer progress and error states, improved destructive-action confirmations, and more privacy-friendly diagnostic exports.
  • 🛠️ Fix: Fixed rapid layout or Focus changes sometimes leaving Modoki busy, out of sync, or showing the wrong selected layout.
  • 🛠️ Fix: Fixed previously auto-quit apps sometimes being reopened after an unrelated layout change.
  • 🛠️ Fix: Multiple fixes around creating, applying, restoring, updating, and deleting layouts for a smoother and more reliable experience.

Known Issues

  • If you have the "Show dock icon" setting turned off and open the app through Spotlight, the dock icon might not disappear after closing the app window.
  • Switching between layouts too fast can result in an error. Try again after a short delay.
